summary: Purpose: compact renewal tracker focused on ‘playline’ (action → escalation → timeframe) rather than just probability. Combines quantitative ARR/probability with qualitative signals (Health Index, Playline Score). Intended for weekly CS sync and QBR prep; encourages early escalation on >6 Playline Score accounts.
playbook_snippet: Playline score 1-3: Auto-renew path; send QBR + expansion deck; close by owner without escalation.
Playline score 4-6: Intervention path; schedule product deep-dive, collect feature signoffs, propose pilot if performance risk.
Playline score 7-9: SWAT path; immediate AE + Legal + Product briefing; offer tailored concession or short-term extension tied to delivery milestones.
Critical (9+): Exec engagement and hotspot timeline within 7 days; potential escrow of business continuity plan.
assumptions: Health Index comb: usage (40%), support volume (30%), NPS proxy (30%) normalized 0-100.
Playline Score derived from Health Index, contract leverage, recent escalations: lower score = healthier; mapped 1-10.
Renewal Probability = baseline from historical cohort adjusted by Playline Score (+/- 20% cap) and QBR sentiment.
ARR numbers represent committed ARR (no expansion) unless flagged in notes.
